evidence.detail: Detached HEAD exactly matches the launcher target; the base resolves exactly; the worktree was clean before and after review.
evidence.reference: git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse 98a20bc479b55b1cdab5e8958ed3630bff0e044a; git status --short

evidence.detail: The exact base-to-target diff adds the Graph client, policies endpoint, tests, and issue governance records across 14 files.

Static inspection found paging bounds and cycle detection, exact-host HTTPS validation, redirect refusal, defensive nested-object normalization, structured Graph errors, and no policy/token persistence or logging in the candidate changes.
The independently runnable non-socket test subset passed: 34 tests, exit 0. The exact command was PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest tests.test_graph tests.test_auth.

The full required suite ran 52 tests but exited 1 because all 13 server integration tests were denied loopback socket binding by the review sandbox; 39 tests completed before those environment errors.
The required compile check exited 1 because the read-only checkout denied creation of __pycache__.
Governance validation exited 1 because the sandbox provided no writable temporary directory.

The candidate records author-reported out-of-band evidence of 52 passing tests, successful compilation, and successful governance validation, but those claims are not independent reviewer execution evidence.

evidence: AGENTS.md states that issue work permits at most two repair rounds, that tighter limits remain binding, and that reaching a limit blocks for an exact human decision.
The candidate identifies itself as repair round 3 in project/issues/ISSUE-0003.md, project/status/CURRENT.md, and project/handoffs/ISSUE-0003-handoff.md.

DECISION-007 attempts to establish approximately four repair rounds as a standing policy. This conflicts with the higher-authority AGENTS.md rule that lower-level records may not weaken a safety gate.
DECISION-004 and DECISION-005 independently retain the two-repair-round limit.
findings.remediation: Stop the issue workflow and obtain a current, explicit human decision that resolves the conflict with the binding two-round limit for this exact candidate, or restore a workflow state consistent with AGENTS.md. Do not treat DECISION-007's standing four-round policy as overriding AGENTS.md.

findings.verification: Verify that the authoritative instructions and committed status consistently authorize review and disposition of exact candidate 065675e53ee8de5a7b9fb48542aa4ba970712a59 without weakening the repository's repair-limit gate.

evidence: The required full test command exited 1: 13 server integration tests could not bind a loopback socket under the review sandbox.
The required py_compile command exited 1 because the checkout is read-only.
The governance validator exited 1 because no writable temporary directory was available.

Repository review rules require BLOCKED when execution evidence cannot be independently verified. DECISION-004 permits the human to disposition this recurring limitation downstream but does not turn author claims into reviewer evidence.
findings.remediation: Use the documented DECISION-004 human gate with the exact out-of-band results bound to this target SHA, or provide a review environment where the required checks can run independently.
findings.title: Required independent execution evidence remains unavailable
findings.verification: Against exact commit 065675e53ee8de5a7b9fb48542aa4ba970712a59, run python3 -m py_compile $(git ls-files '*.py'), python3 -m unittest discover -s tests, and python3 scripts/validate_repo.py in an environment supporting bytecode/temp writes and loopback sockets; record commands, exits, and outputs.

limitations: The review sandbox is read-only, has no writable temporary directory, and denies loopback socket binding; consequently the full required checks could not pass independently.
No live Microsoft Graph fetch was attempted because it is explicitly a protected action and not an ISSUE-0003 completion criterion.
The author-reported 52-test, compile, and governance results were inspected only as claims; they were not independently reproduced in full.
Static review found no additional unresolved product-code defect in the exact candidate diff, but this does not remove the two blocking evidence/governance findings.
review.summary: BLOCKED. Static review of the exact candidate found the Graph implementation consistent with ISSUE-0003's functional and security scope, and 34 independently runnable Graph/auth tests passed. However, repair round 3 conflicts with the binding two-round workflow limit, and the sandbox prevented independent completion of the full required checks.
